about_the_game:
🌀 A world ruled by Artificial Intelligence... and only nonsense can save us all.

Get ready for a chaotic, hilarious, and totally unpredictable adventure! In Zueirama 2, you play as Zoinho, a pizza delivery guy who becomes an unlikely hero in a world overrun by robots and ruled by a rogue AI determined to eliminate humor and fun from the planet.

You won’t just play one kind of game — you’ll play all of them. This is a genre-blending experience that mixes absurd comedy, explosive action, and meme-fueled gameplay into something you've never seen before.

🎮 Key Features:

  • Wild gameplay variety: From delivering pizzas on a rickety scooter to fighting robotic minions in roguelike arenas, to pulling pranks and exploring platforming stages, the game is packed with unexpected twists.

  • A truly insane story: A sentient AI, kidnapped friends, meme-inspired villains, and a mystical capybara that helps you unlock spiritual upgrades? Yep, all of that is in here.

  • Troll mode activated: Buy goofy items and prank NPCs in dedicated mini-games. Success earns you "Zueira Points" — the ultimate measure of chaos.

  • Power up the nonsense: Unlock abilities like the Air Twerk, Flying Flip-Flop, and Ultra Fast Mode — ridiculous powers with surprising effects.

  • Packed with references: Full of internet culture, meme-inspired madness, and nods to both global and Brazilian pop culture — all with original characters and flair.

  • Gorgeously absurd world: From pixelated streets to neon-drenched dystopias, explore handcrafted levels full of easter eggs, secrets, and satire.

🤖 Only stupidity can defeat smart machines

The AI wants order. You bring pure chaos. In a world where fun is forbidden, can you be the last hero of nonsense?

short_description: Natural Unintelligence: Zueirama 2, is a wild comedy adventure with varied gameplay. A rogue AI has lost control and threatens to erase all fun from the world! In this chaotic and hilarious adventure, fight back with pizza, pranks, and meme-fueled madness. Only the power of zueira can save humanity!
